name: Brainport Development N.V.
note: Regional economic-development company (economische ontwikkelingsmaatschappij) behind the Brainport Eindhoven region brand. Its shareholders are five public authorities: Metropoolregio Eindhoven (on behalf of 21 municipalities in Southeast Brabant) and the municipalities of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven and Best. Regional and local Dutch government; governance also runs through Stichting Brainport, a triple-helix body of companies, knowledge institutions and governments chaired by Eindhoven's mayor.
